package auth

// Writes jose-cases.json: ID token headers and key sets, each with whether go-oidc v3.21.0 and
// go-jose v4.1.4 accept the token. See README.md.

import (
	"context"
	"crypto"
	"crypto/ecdsa"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/elliptic"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/rsa"
	"crypto/sha1"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"crypto/x509"
	"crypto/x509/pkix"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"math/big"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/coreos/go-oidc/v3/oidc"
)

type joseCase struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	// A token or a key set; the top-level token and jwks stand in for the one left out.
	Token string `json:"token,omitempty"`
	JWKS  string `json:"jwks,omitempty"`
	OK    bool   `json:"ok"`
}

func TestDumpJoseCases(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("JOSE_CASES_PATH")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("JOSE_CASES_PATH not set")
	}
	key, _ := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
	other, _ := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
	b64 := base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString
	cert := func(k crypto.Signer) []byte {
		tmpl := &x509.Certificate{SerialNumber: big.NewInt(1), Subject: pkix.Name{CommonName: "signing"}, NotBefore: time.Unix(1779192000, 0), NotAfter: time.Unix(1779192000+86400, 0)}
		der, _ := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, tmpl, tmpl, k.Public(), k)
		return der
	}
	leaf, wrongLeaf := cert(key), cert(other)
	sha1Leaf, sha256Leaf := sha1.Sum(leaf), sha256.Sum256(leaf)
	sign := func(header, payload string) string {
		input := b64([]byte(header)) + "." + b64([]byte(payload))
		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(input))
		sig, _ := rsa.SignPKCS1v15(rand.Reader, key, crypto.SHA256, digest[:])
		return input + "." + b64(sig)
	}
	const payload = `{"iss":"https://id.example","sub":"employee-1"}`
	plain := sign(`{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1"}`, payload)
	n := b64(key.PublicKey.N.Bytes())
	good := `"kty":"RSA","kid":"k1","alg":"RS256","use":"sig","n":"` + n + `","e":"AQAB"`
	std := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString
	zeros := b64(make([]byte, 32))
	ecJWK := func(k *ecdsa.PrivateKey, more string) string {
		size := (k.Curve.Params().BitSize + 7) / 8
		return `{"kty":"EC","crv":"` + k.Curve.Params().Name + `","x":"` + b64(k.X.FillBytes(make([]byte, size))) + `","y":"` + b64(k.Y.FillBytes(make([]byte, size))) + `"` + more + `}`
	}
	ecKey := func(c elliptic.Curve) string {
		k, _ := ecdsa.GenerateKey(c, rand.Reader)
		return ecJWK(k, "")
	}
	ec1, _ := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
	ec2, _ := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P384(), rand.Reader)
	ed, edPriv, _ := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)

	var cases []joseCase
	header := func(name, header string) {
		cases = append(cases, joseCase{Name: name, Token: sign(header, payload)})
	}
	header("plain", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1"}`)
	header("crit naming an unknown header", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","crit":["example"],"example":true}`)
	header("crit empty", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","crit":[]}`)
	header("crit null", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","crit":null}`)
	header("crit b64", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","crit":["b64"]}`)
	header("crit b64 and another", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","crit":["b64","example"]}`)
	header("crit a string", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","crit":"b64"}`)
	header("crit with null", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","crit":["b64",null]}`)
	header("crit in other case", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","Crit":["example"]}`)
	header("crit repeated, last unknown", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","crit":null,"crit":["example"]}`)
	header("crit repeated, last null", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","crit":["example"],"crit":null}`)
	header("b64 false", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","b64":false}`)
	header("b64 false and crit b64", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","b64":false,"crit":["b64"]}`)
	header("b64 true", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","b64":true}`)
	header("b64 a string", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","b64":"false"}`)
	header("b64 null", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","b64":null}`)
	header("b64 in other case", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","B64":false}`)
	header("an unknown member repeated", `{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","x":1,"x":2}`)
	// Signed over the raw payload as RFC 7797 says; the Rust port refuses it.
	rawInput := b64([]byte(`{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","b64":false,"crit":["b64"]}`)) + "." + payload
	rawDigest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(rawInput))
	rawSig, _ := rsa.SignPKCS1v15(rand.Reader, key, crypto.SHA256, rawDigest[:])
	cases = append(cases, joseCase{Name: "b64 false signed over the raw payload", Token: b64([]byte(`{"alg":"RS256","kid":"k1","b64":false,"crit":["b64"]}`)) + "." + b64([]byte(payload)) + "." + b64(rawSig)})

	set := func(name, body string) {
		cases = append(cases, joseCase{Name: name, JWKS: body})
	}
	extra := func(name, key string) {
		set(name, `{"keys":[{`+good+`},`+key+`]}`)
	}
	set("good key", `{"keys":[{`+good+`}]}`)
	set("keys null", `{"keys":null}`)
	set("a null key", `{"keys":[null]}`)
	set("a numeric key", `{"keys":[5]}`)
	set("keys in other case", `{"KEYS":[{`+good+`}]}`)
	set("keys an object", `{"keys":{}}`)
	set("body not an object", `[]`)
	extra("missing e", `{"kty":"RSA","alg":"RS256","n":"AQAB"}`)
	extra("e null", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"AQAB","e":null}`)
	extra("e empty", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"AQAB","e":""}`)
	extra("missing n", `{"kty":"RSA","e":"AQAB"}`)
	extra("n a number", `{"kty":"RSA","n":5,"e":"AQAB"}`)
	extra("n bad base64", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"!!","e":"AQAB"}`)
	extra("n padded", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"AQAB==","e":"AQAB"}`)
	extra("n standard alphabet", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"++//","e":"AQAB"}`)
	extra("RSA private", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"`+n+`","e":"AQAB","d":"AQAB"}`)
	extra("unknown kty", `{"kty":"XYZ"}`)
	extra("kty in lower case", `{"kty":"rsa","n":"AQAB"}`)
	extra("no kty", `{"n":"AQAB","e":"AQAB"}`)
	extra("kty a number", `{"kty":5}`)
	extra("folded member names", `{"KTY":"RSA","N":"AQAB"}`)
	extra("repeated member", `{"kty":"XYZ","kid":"a","kid":"b"}`)
	extra("alg folded and unknown", `{"ALG":"RS1","kty":"RSA"}`)
	extra("unknown kty with bad n", `{"kty":"XYZ","n":"!!"}`)
	extra("unknown kty with a numeric kid", `{"kty":"XYZ","kid":5}`)
	extra("unknown kty with bad x5c", `{"kty":"XYZ","x5c":["!!"]}`)
	extra("unknown kty with another key's x5c", `{"kty":"XYZ","x5c":["`+std(wrongLeaf)+`"]}`)
	extra("unknown kty with bad x5t", `{"kty":"XYZ","x5t":"!!"}`)
	extra("Ed448", `{"kty":"OKP","crv":"Ed448","x":"AA"}`)
	extra("OKP without crv", `{"kty":"OKP","x":"AA"}`)
	extra("Ed25519 without x", `{"kty":"OKP","crv":"Ed25519"}`)
	extra("Ed25519 short x", `{"kty":"OKP","crv":"Ed25519","x":"AA"}`)
	extra("Ed25519 long x", `{"kty":"OKP","crv":"Ed25519","x":"`+b64(make([]byte, 40))+`"}`)
	extra("Ed25519 private", `{"kty":"OKP","crv":"Ed25519","x":"`+zeros+`","d":"AA"}`)
	extra("EC short coordinates", `{"kty":"EC","crv":"P-256","x":"AA","y":"AA"}`)
	extra("EC off the curve", `{"kty":"EC","crv":"P-256","x":"`+zeros+`","y":"`+zeros+`"}`)
	extra("EC without y", `{"kty":"EC","crv":"P-256","x":"`+zeros+`"}`)
	extra("EC unknown curve", `{"kty":"EC","crv":"secp256k1","x":"`+zeros+`","y":"`+zeros+`"}`)
	extra("EC P-256 point", ecKey(elliptic.P256()))
	extra("EC P-521 point", ecKey(elliptic.P521()))
	extra("EC key with its x5c", ecJWK(ec1, `,"x5c":["`+std(cert(ec1))+`"]`))
	extra("P-384 key with its x5c", ecJWK(ec2, `,"x5c":["`+std(cert(ec2))+`"]`))
	extra("EC key with another curve's x5c", ecJWK(ec1, `,"x5c":["`+std(cert(ec2))+`"]`))
	extra("EC key with an RSA x5c", ecJWK(ec1, `,"x5c":["`+std(leaf)+`"]`))
	extra("Ed25519 key with its x5c", `{"kty":"OKP","crv":"Ed25519","x":"`+b64(ed)+`","x5c":["`+std(cert(edPriv))+`"]}`)
	extra("Ed25519 key with an RSA x5c", `{"kty":"OKP","crv":"Ed25519","x":"`+b64(ed)+`","x5c":["`+std(leaf)+`"]}`)
	extra("ES256K skipped by alg", `{"kty":"EC","crv":"secp256k1","alg":"ES256K"}`)
	extra("unknown alg skipped", `{"kty":"RSA","alg":"RS1"}`)
	extra("alg a number", `{"kty":"RSA","alg":5}`)
	extra("alg null", `{"kty":"RSA","alg":null,"n":"AQAB"}`)
	extra("oct", `{"kty":"oct","k":"AAAA"}`)
	extra("oct without k", `{"kty":"oct"}`)
	extra("oct with x5c", `{"kty":"oct","k":"AAAA","x5c":["`+std(leaf)+`"]}`)
	extra("x5u not a URL", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"AQAB","e":"AQAB","x5u":"%zz"}`)
	extra("x5u relative", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"AQAB","e":"AQAB","x5u":"keys/1"}`)
	extra("x5t bad base64", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"AQAB","e":"AQAB","x5t":"!!"}`)
	extra("x5t wrong size", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"AQAB","e":"AQAB","x5t":"AAAA"}`)
	extra("x5t as hex", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"AQAB","e":"AQAB","x5t":"`+b64([]byte(strings.Repeat("ab", 20)))+`"}`)
	extra("x5t as bad hex", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"AQAB","e":"AQAB","x5t":"`+b64([]byte(strings.Repeat("zz", 20)))+`"}`)
	extra("x5t#S256 wrong size", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"AQAB","e":"AQAB","x5t#S256":"AAAA"}`)
	extra("x5t#S256 as hex", `{"kty":"RSA","n":"AQAB","e":"AQAB","x5t#S256":"`+b64([]byte(strings.Repeat("ab", 32)))+`"}`)
	set("good key with its x5c and thumbprints", `{"keys":[{`+good+`,"x5c":["`+std(leaf)+`"],"x5t":"`+b64(sha1Leaf[:])+`","x5t#S256":"`+b64(sha256Leaf[:])+`"}]}`)
	set("good key with hex thumbprints", `{"keys":[{`+good+`,"x5c":["`+std(leaf)+`"],"x5t":"`+b64([]byte(hex.EncodeToString(sha1Leaf[:])))+`"}]}`)
	set("good key with a chain", `{"keys":[{`+good+`,"x5c":["`+std(leaf)+`","`+std(wrongLeaf)+`"]}]}`)
	set("good key with another key's x5c", `{"keys":[{`+good+`,"x5c":["`+std(wrongLeaf)+`"]}]}`)
	set("good key with a wrong x5t", `{"keys":[{`+good+`,"x5c":["`+std(leaf)+`"],"x5t":"`+b64(make([]byte, 20))+`"}]}`)
	set("good key with a wrong x5t#S256", `{"keys":[{`+good+`,"x5c":["`+std(leaf)+`"],"x5t#S256":"`+zeros+`"}]}`)
	set("good key with x5c in URL alphabet", `{"keys":[{`+good+`,"x5c":["`+b64(leaf)+`"]}]}`)
	set("good key with x5c not a certificate", `{"keys":[{`+good+`,"x5c":["AAAA"]}]}`)
	set("good key with x5c and trailing bytes", `{"keys":[{`+good+`,"x5c":["`+std(append(append([]byte{}, leaf...), 0))+`"]}]}`)
	set("good key with use enc", `{"keys":[{"kty":"RSA","kid":"k1","alg":"RS256","use":"enc","n":"`+n+`","e":"AQAB"}]}`)
	set("good key with RS384 alg", `{"keys":[{"kty":"RSA","kid":"k1","alg":"RS384","n":"`+n+`","e":"AQAB"}]}`)

	plainJWKS := `{"keys":[{` + good + `}]}`
	ctx := context.Background()
	for i, c := range cases {
		token, body := plain, plainJWKS
		if c.Token != "" {
			token = c.Token
		}
		if c.JWKS != "" {
			body = c.JWKS
		}
		srv := httptest.NewTLSServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(body))
		}))
		cctx := oidc.ClientContext(ctx, srv.Client())
		keys := oidc.NewRemoteKeySet(cctx, srv.URL)
		v := oidc.NewVerifier("https://id.example", keys, &oidc.Config{SkipClientIDCheck: true, SkipExpiryCheck: true, SupportedSigningAlgs: []string{"RS256"}})
		_, err := v.Verify(cctx, token)
		cases[i].OK = err == nil
		srv.Close()
	}
	doc, _ := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"token": plain, "jwks": plainJWKS, "cases": cases}, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(doc, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
